SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.email, u.phone, u.avatar_url, u.gender, u.status, u.last_login_time, u.last_login_ip, u.token_version, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.deleted FROM sys_user u
INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id AND r.role_code = #{role} AND r.status = 1
WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND u.status = #{status}
ORDER BY u.user_id ASC
